description:
Is this Solana token a rug or safe to buy? Binary safety verdict — call it
    BEFORE buying or paying for any Solana meme token.

    Returns verdict SAFE/RISKY/RUG/UNKNOWN + action ENTER_OK/CAUTION/SKIP +
    confidence + specific red flags (active mint/freeze authority, dev dump,
    sell pressure, whale distribution, thin liquidity) + measured signals
    (unique wallets, buy share, bonding-curve liquidity, graduation status).
    Built from our own pump.fun/Meteora collector: 12M+ swap events, 63k
    launchpads, 1.3M whale wallets. Unknown mint returns UNKNOWN — never "safe".
    REST: GET /api/v1/solana/mint/{mint}/rug-check ($0.02).

    Args:
        mint: Solana token mint address
name: mint_rug_check
